description: A React component file defining the 'NewChat' component for managing chat sessions, with subcomponents like MaskItem, hooks for handling mask grouping, and UI interactions. Includes features such as mask selection, navigation, and responsive design.

classes.name: MaskItem
classes.description: A React subcomponent for rendering individual mask options with avatar and name.

methods.name: useMaskGroup
methods.description: Custom hook to group masks dynamically based on the size of the app body element.

methods.name: startChat
methods.description: Function to initiate a new chat session with an optional mask, navigating to the chat page.
